# AI Jungle

Human-directed, AI-executed.

What. A business performance system for owner-led firms: we rethink strategy with AI, install and operate agents built on your firm's own processes, and train your team to run them. They fill your pipeline and absorb the grunt work.

How it works. Four phases: Rethink (Leverage Assessment), Build (first install), Operate (partnership), Train (your team runs it). The Leverage Assessment is $999, published on /assessment, fully credited toward the first install, and free if it cannot find three installable opportunities. Install is typically $7,500 to $15,000, fixed. Partnership is from $5,000/month plus a performance share. Six-month minimum.

Who it serves. Owner-led firms: consulting, advisory, executive search, wealth and professional services, 5 to 50 people, where growth still runs on the founder's hours.

Control. Nothing ships without your yes. Every message, quote and post holds in one approval ledger until the owner approves, in the messaging app you already use (Telegram).

Proof. Every client from day one is still a client. Six systems in production across pipeline, operations, research and brand. Case level: 139 qualified meetings booked in 3 months, 24% reply rate, 90 held, 0 messages without approval. For scale: cold outreach averages a 3.4% reply rate (Instantly 2026 benchmark).

Privacy. Each client runs in a private, secured environment. Your data stays yours, your models if you prefer, no lock-in.

Start. Start with the Leverage Assessment, or book a 30-minute call at https://cal.welcometotheaijungle.com/loic/intro if you already know the work you want scoped. Prefer email? hello@welcometotheaijungle.com

This site is The Living Pitch: it rebuilds itself in public. Every change is proposed by an agent, approved by a human, and receipted on /evolution. Agents are welcome: the pitch, the scan, the roast and the booking are exposed as WebMCP tools on the home page.
